requirements.text: The system must provide a Registration module for citizens to file complaints and for police to initiate the investigation process.
The system must provide an Investigation module to automate tasks and improve operational efficiency post-registration.
The system must provide a Prosecution module to record and manage court interactions.
The system must provide a Search module for basic and advanced queries on cases, persons, crimes, modus operandi, and property.
The system must provide a Citizen Interface module for information exchange and status acknowledgments between citizens and police.
The system must provide a Navigation module with role-based landing pages showing assigned cases, alerts, and pending tasks.
The system must provide a Configuration module to manage state-specific data, rules, acts, and sections.
The system must provide a Support module for logging and tracking defects or enhancement requests with automated email/SMS alerts.
The system must maintain an unalterable audit trail capturing all CRUD actions on critical entities, user IDs, timestamps, and administrative changes.
The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) allowing users to be members of multiple groups and limiting access to cases based on security levels.
The system must support SSL/HTTPS encrypted connections, 2-way digital signatures, and VPN connections for secure data transmission.
The system must prevent common vulnerabilities including SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), and ensure input validation/sanitization.
The system must perform simple searches within 5-8 seconds and advanced searches within 10-15 seconds.
The system must retrieve frequently accessed cases (last 2 months) within 5-8 seconds and infrequent cases within 20 seconds.
The system must provide context-sensitive help material accessible in both online and offline modes.
The system must comply with ISO 9241 standards for usability and accessibility, including support for users with special needs.
The system must support a multilingual interface and allow users to customize UI elements like layouts, fonts, and colors.
The system must be built on a 3-tier architecture using SOA principles to support centralized deployment and maintenance.
The system must support an offline mode for critical functionality and ensure no data loss during equipment or network failure.
The system must be compatible with multiple web browsers and support access via PDAs and mobile data terminals.
The system shall allow users to create, edit, and view customer account profiles, including contact and payment information.
The system shall provide an inventory management interface for administrators to add, delete, and update product details, categories, and images.
The system shall provide a shopping cart feature allowing customers to add, remove, and view items with total cost calculation.
The system shall provide an order confirmation process that allows customers to review order details before final submission.
The system shall provide a search engine to allow customers to find products based on search criteria.
The system shall implement a plug-in API to allow for future software enhancements and custom functionality.
The system shall send automated email confirmations to customers upon successful order placement.
The system shall support user roles including System Administrator, Sales Personnel, and Customer with appropriate access privileges.
The system shall use Secure Socket Layer (SSL) for all sensitive data transmission.
The system shall encrypt all customer data stored in the database.
The system shall implement protection against IP-based Denial of Service (DOS) attacks.
The system shall detect and respond to consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall be operational within 1 minute of the USB device being plugged in.
The system shall support 1000 concurrent logged-in users.
The system shall be capable of retrieving 200 products per second.
The system shall perform product searches in less than 1 second.
The system shall maintain an availability of 99.99%.
The system shall be compatible with Microsoft Internet Explorer 6/7 and Netscape Communicator 4/5.
The system shall provide online help and tooltips for administrators, sales personnel, and customers.
The system shall operate on an Intel-based system with Slackware Linux 2.6 and Apache Web Server.
The system shall use a SQL-based database for inventory storage.
The XML Services (XS) shall provide functionality for the registration of XML terms, tags, and structures.
The XS shall provide tools for the design, generation, and consumption of XML schemas and documents.
The system shall provide a registry for producers to submit metadata, XML tag specifications, and related information resource artifacts.
The system shall support both online interactive and offline batch processes for metadata submission.
The system shall provide consumers with discovery capabilities, including viewing tag relationships (ancestor/descendant, parent/child), data types, and versioning.
The system shall provide search functionality for XML tags based on name, definition, or subscriber/author.
The system shall support the processing of ANSI standard SQL as specified in FIPS PUB 127-2.
The system shall provide notification capabilities for users to subscribe to changes in Information Resources.
The system shall support the generation of XML documents and schemas, including dynamic cross-referencing and indexing of XML objects.
The system shall provide XML parsers (DOM, SAX) to check conformance, well-formedness, and validation of XML documents.
In fixed environments, data management services shall be tunable by on-site personnel to adjust for varying workloads and database sizes.
The system shall allow users to define and reset session time-out values prior to initialization to accommodate degraded communications environments.
The system shall support managing various types of data, database architectures, and hardware/software platforms across distributed sites.
The system shall support management of usernames, superusers, and user permissions/privileges.
The system shall provide a web-based interface for viewing Information Resources, including individual web pages for each resource.
The XS software shall be portable and execute on DII COE-compliant platforms.
The XS shall internally interface with existing data elements of the DBIF, DAC, and COTS RDBMS products (Sybase, Oracle, Informix).
The XS shall be delivered in accordance with DII COE packaging guidelines.
